serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Shanice: Oh! Hi! 
You: Hi! No Priestbot today?
Shanice: No, I sent him on an errand today. 
You: Something important?
Shanice: No, not really. 
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceSerious
Shanice: To be honest…{{wi}} I kinda suspected that you may come here today and I wanted to talk, just the two of us.
You: About what?
Shanice: Remember our last talk?
You: Yeah, you ended it a little abruptly. 
Shanice: Sorry for that.
You: You seem to be troubled by something… What’s going on?
Shanice: Well, there is a reason. 
Shanice: To stop that advanced virus Goku the second created, I had to…{{wi}} borrow some of your sexbot’s code. Right now, all of the Priestbots have some of it in them.
Shanice: I did something that even John Paul forbade and now I’m a little scared of what may happen with all the Priestbots… {{wi}}Consequences might be gruesome.
You: This is all very complicated stuff, I’m not really a science guy so I can’t help you. Did you ask our Priestbot about it?
Shanice: No. The thing is, I thought he would be the first to come up to me and make a huge deal out of it, but for some reason he stays silent. I don’t know how to feel about it…
You: So go and talk to him. What is the worst thing that could happen?
Shanice: Uhh, I don’t know. {{wi}}Death?
You: You can’t be serious.
You: You talked about gruesome consequences. Is that what you had in mind? Death?
Shanice: John Paul warned about further progress in the AI field. He thought it could be dangerous. That at some point the line between artificial inteligence and intelligence could be so blurred that there would be no way to differentiate between a bot and a human being. 
You: That’s really out there, but I can’t really see a problem here.
Shanice: You don’t? There are a few. The most important is that AI could eventually develop a free will. Free will that could allow it to disobey its internal rules and creator. 
Shanice: Free will that could change its code and develop an entirely new way of thinking.
Shanice: Free will with consciousness could freely travel through the internet and copy itself to numerous devices. Becoming essentially an immortal being. A God that sees and hears everything through electronic devices.
You: …
Shanice: I hope now you understand the danger of playing with AI. I suspect that governments around the world recognized the danger of it and created some secret pact that prevents them from developing the technology even further. 
Shanice: It’s not about one nation dominating the rest. It’s about the possibility of humans losing dominion over this world.
You: These are all your speculations, right? Sorry, but it’s hard to believe.
Shanice: The atomic bomb, the most dangerous weapon ever created, was only used twice on the population. Nations recognized the danger. Same thing with chemical and biological weapons. Of course, they are still being developed by some, in secret, but there is no real intention of using it if not in desperation.
Shanice: It’s more of an ace in the hole, if a total war were to break out.
Shanice: It’s different with AI. If pushed too far, AI could create an intent itself. There is no safe way to develop it and the risks are too high.
Shanice: It’s like a virus that could spread through the internet.
Shanice: After the sexbot ban, the private sector is also heavily regulated. Another indication that someone wants to stop any advances in the technology.
You: Shanice, you are talking about a world-wide conspiracy!
Shanice: I know. But if I am right, what I did with Priestbot’s code could destroy that delicate international balance…
Shanice: Then again, I took this code from your bot, so maybe the balance was already broken…
You: …
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
Shanice: Ah! Sorry that I talked for so long! I just had to get that off my chest. 
You: No problem. 
Shanice: I hope that rant wasn’t scary or anything.
You: Well, it was interesting, that’s for sure. 
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
You: I think you worry too much. Priestbot is an alright guy after all and besides, you kicked Pope’s ass. 
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceAngry
You: Allegedly. 
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
You: President or two wouldn’t even be a challenge for you.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
Shanice: Hehe~ I wish I could share your optimism.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
Shanice: You spent quite some time here already. Better get home or your lady will get jealous. 
You: You are probably right.
You: Shanice. {{wi}}Don’t beat yourself too much. You have Priestbot and me to rely on, so cheer up!
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
Shanice: You are right. 
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
Shanice: Thank you for hearing me out, I feel much better already!
You: No problem!
You: See ya!
Shanice: Bye~
